create_sequence_adder: create a SequenceAdder instance with a reverb client, sequence length, and period for fixed-length sequence replay
configure_end_behavior: configure the SequenceAdder end of episode behavior using the EndBehavior enum with WRITE, CONTINUE, ZERO_PAD, or TRUNCATE
generate_reverb_signature: generate a Reverb table signature using SequenceAdder.signature with an environment spec and sequence length
reset_adder_buffer: reset the SequenceAdder buffer by calling reset which respects the end of episode behavior setting
review_endbehavior_enum: review the EndBehavior enum to understand WRITE, CONTINUE, ZERO_PAD, and TRUNCATE options for episode end handling
